source: Installed Steam FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH resources; no external translated text used
parser: CUE4Parse 1.2.2.202610 GAME_FinalFantasy7Rebirth plus a focused Rebirth frozen-image patch reader
extraction_notes: Text resource property index0 is an observed FString locale US/DE. The parser then validates its named string table.
Rebirth frozen images store package FName patch references rather than legacy inline FString names; custom reader validates counts, offsets and row/schema lengths.
Chapter names use exact chapter_title_0001..0014 keys. Character names and aliases join PlayerTable.TextID and explicit ActorName/parameter-format/spec arrays.
Region parent edges come from LocationResident.ChildLocationID_Array. Closest named parent is selected; ambiguous equal-depth parents are omitted.
0001-WORLD (Meridian Ocean) is excluded as a parent region prefix for the continent hierarchy; it remains a valid location in its own right.

Native character IDs0..8 verified by BPGetPlayerExperienceBase RVA12766BC: global rowcache RVA904D0B0 indexed (charId*99+level-1)*40, first-row FNames Cloud01 through Sephiroth01. IDs9..14 contain None and are not guessed.
LocationName gives explicit labels when available; otherwise only existing $mapNNNN labels matching the four-digit location prefix are used.

NaviMapPrototypeDataV2.Locations supplies explicit current-map Name and layer AreaNames/LongName/ShortName text keys. Area keys encode OpenGroupNumber (not VisitGroupNumber or compact AreaNames array index). Only these explicit layer/area associations are exported; unknown labels return empty. Reader must ensure current location/layer/group coherence.
Experience is cumulative PlayerParameter.Experience. Weapon threshold is WeaponUpgradeTreeLevel.Percent for its explicit TreeLevel, despite the misleading Percent field name.
Difficulty labels are included without claiming their numeric runtime enum ordering.
